en: n. soldiers, especially in large groups; a group of people or animals; vi. to move or walk together in a group
ex: The government sent more troops to the border.
政府派出更多軍隊前往邊境。

en: a. in agreement with the facts; real and not imitation; loyal and reliable; accurate; n. the correct position; adv. truthfully
ex: Is it true that you are moving to Taipei next month?
你下個月要搬到台北是真的嗎？

en: n. the thick main stem of a tree; the long nose of an elephant; the main part of the body without the head, arms and legs; a large strong box for storing things; (in the US) the space at the back of a car for luggage
ex: The kids climbed up the thick trunk of the old tree.
孩子們爬上那棵老樹粗壯的樹幹。

en: n. a firm belief that someone or something is reliable and honest; responsibility to take care of someone or something; an organization that holds property for someone; vt. to believe that someone is good and honest; to depend on
ex: Trust is the foundation of any good relationship.
信任是任何良好關係的基礎。

en: n. the real facts about something; the quality of being true; something that is accepted as true
ex: I want to know the truth about what happened.
我想知道事情的真相。

en: a. telling the truth; giving a true and accurate account of something
ex: Please give me a truthful answer.
請給我一個誠實的答案。

en: n. a large round container with a flat bottom, often used for holding liquids; a bathtub; vt. to put something in a tub; vi. to take a bath in a tub
ex: She filled the tub with warm water and added bubble bath.
她在浴缸裡放滿溫水並倒入泡泡浴劑。

en: n. a long hollow cylinder through which liquid or gas can flow; (informal) the underground train system in London; a container with a narrow neck for toothpaste or paint; vt. to put something inside a tube; to send through a tube
ex: She squeezed the last bit of toothpaste out of the tube.
她把最後一點牙膏從軟管裡擠出來。

en: n. an underground passage dug through a hill or under a river or road; vi. to dig a passage under the ground; vt. to dig a tunnel through or under something
ex: The train went through a long tunnel under the mountain.
火車穿過山底下的一條長隧道。
ph: light at the end of the tunnel

en: n. a reptile with a hard shell on its back that lives in the sea; an animal with a hard round shell that lives on land or in fresh water
ex: The sea turtle laid its eggs on the sandy beach.
那隻海龜在沙灘上產卵。

en: n. a private teacher who teaches one student or a small group; a university teacher who guides a small number of students; vt. to teach someone privately; to guide someone
ex: She hired a tutor to help her son with math.
她請了一位家教幫兒子補數學。

en: n. one of two children born from the same pregnancy; one of two similar things; a. consisting of two similar parts; (of a child) born at the same time as a sibling; vi. to give birth to twins
ex: My twin sister and I look exactly the same.
我的雙胞胎妹妹和我長得一模一樣。

en: n. a sudden unexpected change in a story or situation; a bend or turn in something; vt. to turn something around or into a different shape; to change the meaning of something so that it is not true; vi. to twist or wind into a shape
ex: The story has a surprising twist at the end.
這個故事在結尾有個令人驚訝的轉折。

en: n. a very strong tropical storm with violent winds that forms over the western Pacific Ocean
ex: The typhoon forced the airline to cancel all flights.
颱風使航空公司取消了所有航班。

en: a. unpleasant to look at; very unpleasant or threatening; n. an ugly person or thing
ex: The ugly building spoiled the beautiful view.
那棟醜陋的建築破壞了美景。

en: n. a device with a folding frame covered with cloth, used for protection against rain or sun; a protection or an organization that covers many groups; a. covering a wide range of things; vt. to protect with an umbrella
ex: Don't forget to bring your umbrella; it might rain.
別忘了帶傘，可能會下雨。

en: a. lying below the surface; basic or fundamental; not obvious but important
ex: The underlying cause of the problem is poor communication.
問題的根本原因是溝通不良。

en: n. clothes worn next to the skin, under other clothes
ex: He packed socks and underwear for the weekend trip.
他為週末旅行打包了襪子和內衣褲。

en: n. a group of people or countries joined together for a common purpose; the act of joining together; an organization of workers formed to protect their rights
ex: The workers formed a union to demand better pay.
工人們成立工會要求更好的薪資。

en: vi. to come together to form one group; vt. to bring people or things together to act as one; to combine two things into one
ex: The two countries decided to unite against a common enemy.
兩國決定聯合起來對抗共同的敵人。

en: n. a state in which people or things are joined together as one; agreement among people; the quality of being a single whole
ex: The leaders called for unity among all citizens.
領導人呼籲全體公民團結一致。

en: n. all of space and everything in it, including the stars and planets; a particular area of activity or interest; a person's way of seeing the world
ex: Scientists study how the universe began.
科學家研究宇宙的起源。

en: n. an educational institution where students study for degrees and where research is done
ex: She wants to study medicine at a top university.
她想去頂尖大學讀醫學。

en: a. higher in position; of higher rank; at a high level; n. the top part of a shoe; a drug that makes you feel energetic
ex: The books are on the upper shelf of the cabinet.
書放在櫃子的上層。

en: a. on an upper floor of a building; adv. to or on a higher floor; n. the upper floor of a building
ex: The bedrooms are upstairs, and the kitchen is downstairs.
臥室在樓上，廚房在樓下。

en: a. (of a room, seat or position) not being used by anyone; (of a job) not filled; showing no sign of intelligence or emotion
ex: There are no vacant seats on the bus.
公車上沒有空位。

en: n. an area of low land between hills or mountains, often with a river flowing through it; an area of land drained by a river
ex: A small river flows through the green valley.
一條小河流過青翠的山谷。

en: a. worth a lot of money; very useful or important; n. (plural) things that are worth a lot of money
ex: Thank you for your valuable advice.
謝謝你給我寶貴的建議。

en: n. how much something is worth in money; the importance or usefulness of something; vt. to think that something is important; to decide how much something is worth
ex: The value of the house has doubled in ten years.
這棟房子的價值在十年內翻了一倍。

en: n. a small covered vehicle used for carrying goods or people; the front part of an army moving forward; vt. to transport something in a van
ex: The delivery van stopped in front of the shop.
送貨廂型車停在店門口。

en: vi. to suddenly stop being visible; to stop existing; to go away without anyone knowing where
ex: The magician made the coin vanish from his hand.
魔術師讓硬幣從手中消失。

en: n. the quality of being different or varied; a number of different kinds of things; a type of something; a show with songs, dances and comedy
ex: The market sells a wide variety of fresh fruit.
那個市場販售各式各樣的新鮮水果。
ph: variety is the spice of life

en: a. of different kinds; several; separate and different
ex: There are various ways to solve this problem.
有各種方法可以解決這個問題。

en: n. a container, usually made of glass or china, used for holding flowers or as a decoration
ex: She put the roses in a crystal vase.
她把玫瑰插進水晶花瓶。

en: n. a machine such as a car, bus or truck used for carrying people or goods; a means of communicating ideas or feelings
ex: No vehicles are allowed in the park.
公園內禁止車輛進入。

en: n. writing arranged in lines with a regular pattern of sounds; a group of lines in a poem or song; a short division of a chapter in the Bible; vi. to write verse
ex: The first verse of the song is about love.
這首歌的第一段歌詞是關於愛情的。

en: n. a success in a war, competition or struggle; the act of winning
ex: The team celebrated their victory with a parade.
球隊用遊行慶祝勝利。

en: n. the things that can be seen from a particular place; an opinion or way of thinking about something; the ability to see; vt. to look at or consider something; to watch something
ex: The hotel room has a lovely view of the sea.
旅館房間可以看見美麗的海景。

en: n. a small community in the countryside, usually smaller than a town; the people who live in such a community; a. relating to a village
ex: Everyone in the small village knows each other.
這個小村莊的每個人都互相認識。

en: a. using physical force to hurt someone; very strong and powerful; extreme and uncontrolled
ex: The protest turned violent when the police arrived.
警察到場後，抗議活動變得暴力。
